use_cases.name: Run pre-boarding from offer acceptance to day one
use_cases.goal: Complete document collection, verification, medical fitness and asset and IT requests in parallel so the joiner is ready on the date of joining.

stakeholders.interest: A clear list of what to submit and by when.
The joiner is productive from day one.
Factory roles have medical fitness before joining.

preconditions: An approved requisition with an open position exists for the offer.
The offer records joining date, location and worker class.
postconditions_success: All items marked Blocks joining are complete and the joining chain can start on the date of joining.
The person record exists or is ready to be created by the joining chain.
postconditions_failure: The joining date is held or moved and the blocking items are listed on the pre-boarding tracker.

main_flow.action: Records the offer acceptance; the platform instantiates the pre-boarding chain pinned to the current workflow version.
Opens parallel tracks for document collection, verification, medical fitness (factory roles) and asset and IT requests, each with owner and due date.
Uploads identity, address, education, bank and previous-employment documents through the candidate portal.
Verifies documents, rejecting any illegible or mismatched item with a reason for re-upload.
Returns status per verification component as checks complete.
Prepares assets and system access for issue on the joining date.
Runs a readiness check two working days before joining and alerts owners of open blocking items.
Hands the completed record to the joining chain on the date of joining.

alternate_flows.condition: The requisition is held at sanctioned strength.
steps: Platform holds the chain at offer acceptance and shows the requisition block.
The chain resumes when the requisition is released.
Platform lets the joining proceed and carries the item into the joining chain.

exception_flows.condition: A blocking item is still open on the day before joining.
exception_flows.handling: HR operations is asked to move the joining date or obtain a recorded waiver; the joining chain does not start.

exception_flows.condition: The candidate withdraws.
exception_flows.handling: The chain is cancelled, collected documents are retained only as the retention policy allows, and the requisition reopens.

nfrs: Candidate document upload works on a 3G mobile connection for files up to 5 MB.
Identity numbers are masked on every screen after capture.

user_stories.want: pre-boarding tasks to run in parallel with owners and due dates
user_stories.so_that: a joiner is ready on day one without me chasing each department

acceptance.then: document collection, medical fitness and asset tasks are created in parallel, each with owner and due date

acceptance.given: medical fitness for a factory role is open on 2026-08-30
acceptance.then: the owner and HR operations are alerted that a blocking item is open

user_stories.so_that: I can complete joining formalities without repeated calls

acceptance.given: I uploaded a blurred PAN card
acceptance.then: I see the rejection reason and a re-upload option

acceptance.given: all my documents are accepted
acceptance.then: every document item shows Complete

use_cases.name: Complete the joining chain
use_cases.goal: Take a new hire from the date of joining to a fully registered, payroll-ready, inducted employee with statutory forms generated inside the chain.

stakeholders.interest: Bank, payroll group and statutory IDs are in place before the first run.
Form F and registrations are produced in-chain, not chased later.
Induction and assets are ready from day one.

use_cases.trigger: The date of joining arrives for a hire whose pre-boarding is complete.
preconditions: Pre-boarding blocking items are complete.
A joining workflow definition is published for the worker class and location.
Clearance templates exist so allocated assets can be tracked to exit.
postconditions_success: Person and assignment exist with statutory registrations, bank details and payroll group.
Form F and other applicable joining forms are generated and linked to the joiner.
Policy acknowledgements, induction assignments and asset allocations are recorded; the announcement is published.
postconditions_failure: The chain shows open steps with owners, SLAs and blockers on SCR-060; the joiner is not added to payroll until mandatory steps finish.

main_flow.action: Starts the joining chain on the date of joining with the workflow definition version pinned to the instance.
Creates the person and assignment, or adopts those already created at pre-boarding.
Completes statutory registrations: PF/UAN, ESI IP number and professional tax enrolment where applicable.
Generates statutory joining forms, including Form F for factory locations, inside the chain.
Captures bank details, assigns the payroll group, and records nominees and emergency contacts.
Reads and acknowledges assigned policies on SCR-062; the acknowledged policy version is retained.
Assigns the induction learning path and the 30/60/90-day plan through the standard assignment mechanism.
Allocates assets on SCR-064; each allocation is registered as a future clearance item.
Publishes the new-joiner announcement to the audience defined by the audience rule.

alternate_flows.condition: The workflow definition is changed while this chain is in flight.
steps: The instance continues on its pinned version.
New chains started after the change use the new version.

alternate_flows.condition: The person and assignment were already created at pre-boarding.
steps: Platform adopts the existing records instead of creating duplicates.

alternate_flows.condition: The location is an office with no Factory Act applicability.
steps: Platform generates only the joining forms applicable to that location; Form F is not generated.

alternate_flows.condition: HR applies an editorial override to the announcement.
steps: HR edits or suppresses the announcement; the override is recorded with the editor's name.

exception_flows.condition: A registration step breaches its SLA.
exception_flows.handling: The step is escalated to the HR operations lead and shown red on SCR-060.

exception_flows.condition: Form F cannot be generated because a required field is missing.
exception_flows.handling: The step stays open with the missing field named; the chain cannot complete.

exception_flows.condition: Bank details are captured or changed inside an open payroll window.
exception_flows.handling: An alert is raised to the payroll manager for verification before the run.

exception_flows.condition: The employee has not acknowledged a mandatory policy by its due date.
exception_flows.handling: A reminder is sent and the open acknowledgement is carried as a blocker for confirmation.

exception_flows.condition: An asset is not available for issue.
exception_flows.handling: The step stays open with a blocker and an expected issue date.

nfrs: SCR-060 shows chain status for 50 concurrent joiners within 2 seconds.
Bank account numbers are stored tokenised and shown masked except the last four digits.
Each chain step records actor, timestamp and outcome in the audit trail.

user_stories.want: one joining console showing every step, owner, SLA and generated artefact per hire
user_stories.so_that: I can see and clear blockers before the joiner's first payroll

acceptance.then: the step is shown overdue and has been escalated to the HR operations lead

use_cases.name: Confirm an employee at the end of probation
use_cases.goal: Confirm, extend or end probation on time, gated by mandatory induction completion, and issue the confirmation letter.

stakeholders.interest: A timely decision and letter.
Confirmation and dependent events (referral payout, leave credit) fall on the same date.

use_cases.trigger: The probation end date is 30 days away.
preconditions: Date of joining and probation months are recorded on the assignment.
The confirmation letter template is published for the entity.
postconditions_success: The assignment carries the confirmation date or a new probation end date.
A confirmation or extension letter is issued with the template version retained.
Dependent triggers such as a maturing referral award have fired.
postconditions_failure: Confirmation stays pending with the blocker recorded; probation status continues.

main_flow.action: Raises a confirmation task to the manager 30 days before the confirmation due date.
Records the assessment and recommends confirm, extend probation or end employment.
Checks gates: all mandatory induction items complete and policy acknowledgements recorded.
Reviews the recommendation and gates and actions the decision.
Updates the assignment with the confirmation date and fires dependent triggers.
Generates the confirmation letter on SCR-067 from the current template version for HR to issue.
Receives the letter in self-service and acknowledges receipt.

steps: Manager states reason and extension period.
HR approves; platform sets the new probation end date and issues an extension letter.
HR operations routes the case to the Director / approver.
On approval the separation process starts.

exception_flows.condition: A mandatory induction item is still open.
exception_flows.handling: Confirmation cannot be actioned whatever the manager recommends; the blocker is named.

exception_flows.condition: The manager does not respond within 7 days.
exception_flows.handling: The task is escalated to the manager's manager and HR operations.

nfrs: Issued letters are immutable and retain the template version used.

user_stories.want: confirmation blocked while any mandatory induction item is open
user_stories.so_that: no one is confirmed without completing required training

acceptance.given: E1066 has harassment-prevention awareness IND-2026-0090 in progress
acceptance.then: the action is blocked and IND-2026-0090 is named as the blocker

acceptance.given: E1058 has all induction items complete and a Confirm recommendation
acceptance.then: the assignment shows confirmed from 2026-09-01 and a confirmation letter is generated

user_stories.want: a reminder 30 days before my team member's confirmation date
user_stories.so_that: I assess on time

acceptance.given: E1060's confirmation is due 2026-10-06
acceptance.then: I receive a confirmation task for E1060

acceptance.given: I recommend extending probation by 3 months for below-par performance
acceptance.then: the new probation end date is 2027-01-06 and an extension letter is generated

use_cases.name: Process a promotion or transfer
use_cases.goal: Apply an approved promotion or transfer from its effective date and re-resolve every location-dependent rule.

stakeholders.interest: PT, LWF and pay changes apply from the right date with correct proration.
Holidays, rest days and access match the new location.

use_cases.trigger: A promotion or transfer is approved.
preconditions: The change is approved through its workflow.
The target position, location and grade exist.
postconditions_success: A new effective-dated assignment row exists and the old row ends the day before.
PT, LWF, holiday calendar, rest-day pattern and location scope are re-resolved.
A letter is issued and affected roles' data scopes are updated.
postconditions_failure: The current assignment continues unchanged and the change is held with its reason.

main_flow.action: Opens the approved change and confirms effective date, target position, grade, location and manager.
Creates the new effective-dated assignment and ends the current one the day before.
Re-resolves professional tax, labour welfare fund, holiday calendar, rest-day pattern and location scope for the new location.
Flags the payroll period for split computation if the effective date is mid-period.
Updates manager and plant HR data scopes so the new team can see the employee and the old team cannot.
Generates and issues the promotion or transfer letter on SCR-067.
Notifies the employee, old manager and new manager.

alternate_flows.condition: The change is a promotion within the same location.
steps: Platform updates grade and pay only; location-dependent rules are not re-resolved.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date falls inside a locked payroll period.
exception_flows.handling: The change is held and HR is asked to choose the next open date or raise an arrears instruction.

exception_flows.condition: The target location has no holiday calendar or PT configuration.
exception_flows.handling: The change is held and the missing configuration is named.

nfrs: Effective-dated history is preserved and queryable as at any date.

user_stories.want: a transfer to re-resolve professional tax for the new state from the effective date
user_stories.so_that: the employee is not taxed under the old state

acceptance.then: professional tax is computed on the Maharashtra slab

acceptance.given: the transfer is effective 2026-10-16
acceptance.then: the period is split and both states' rules are applied to their portions

user_stories.want: a transferred employee to appear in my scope from the effective date
user_stories.so_that: I can manage their attendance from day one

use_cases.name: Submit and process a resignation with notice
use_cases.goal: Record a resignation, fix the last working day and notice position, and start clearance in parallel.

stakeholders.interest: Notice shortfall or buyout is known for F&F.
Time for handover and backfill.

preconditions: The employee holds an active assignment with a notice period defined by policy.
postconditions_success: The resignation is accepted with last working day and notice served or short computed.
The clearance checklist is instantiated on acceptance.
postconditions_failure: The resignation is withdrawn or remains pending with its status visible to the employee.

main_flow.action: Submits a resignation from self-service with reason and proposed last working day.
Computes required notice, notice served and any shortfall from the policy and proposed date.
Reviews, records a retention conversation if any, and recommends acceptance with a last working day.
Accepts the resignation and confirms the last working day and any buyout or recovery decision.
Instantiates the clearance checklist on acceptance so clearance runs in parallel with notice.
Notifies payroll of the last working day and notice position for F&F.

steps: The resignation is cancelled and no checklist is created.
HR records the waived notice days and reason.
Platform recomputes the shortfall as zero for waived days.

exception_flows.condition: The manager does not act within 3 working days.
exception_flows.handling: The item is escalated to HR operations.

exception_flows.condition: No clearance template matches the worker class and location.
exception_flows.handling: HR operations is alerted and the checklist must be created before acceptance completes.

nfrs: The resignation and every status change are timestamped and visible to the employee.

user_stories.want: to see my required notice and any shortfall when I propose a last working day
user_stories.so_that: I know the financial effect before I submit

acceptance.then: the screen shows 30 days required, 30 served and no shortfall

acceptance.then: a 10-day shortfall is shown

user_stories.so_that: no-dues finishes by the last working day

acceptance.then: it shows Withdrawn and no checklist exists

use_cases.name: Clear no-dues before full and final settlement
use_cases.goal: Clear every departmental no-dues item in parallel with notice so F&F can settle on the last working day, holding F&F while any blocking item is open.

stakeholders.interest: Settlement on the last working day.
No settlement is released with unrecovered dues.
Assets are returned or recovered.

preconditions: A clearance template exists for the worker class and location.
Asset allocations for the leaver are registered.
postconditions_success: Every blocking item is Cleared or Waived with reason; any waived value is a recovery line in F&F.
F&F moves from HELD to READY.
postconditions_failure: F&F remains HELD with the open blocking items listed.

main_flow.action: On resignation acceptance, instantiates the clearance checklist from the template for the worker class and location.
Works each item in parallel with the notice period, recording status, date and note within the item SLA.
Checks whether any blocking item is still open; while one is, F&F stays HELD.
Waives a remaining blocking item explicitly with a reason and a recovery amount where the item has a value.

steps: Platform moves F&F to READY; no waiver is needed.

alternate_flows.condition: A non-blocking item (for example exit interview) is open on the last working day.
steps: The item stays open without holding F&F.

exception_flows.condition: No template matches the worker class and location.
exception_flows.handling: The checklist cannot be created; HR operations is alerted to configure the template.

exception_flows.condition: An item breaches its SLA.
exception_flows.handling: The item is escalated to the owner's manager and highlighted on SCR-061.

exception_flows.condition: A user tries to release F&F while a blocking item is open.
exception_flows.handling: Release is refused and the open items are listed.

exception_flows.condition: A waiver is submitted without a reason or by a role below HR head.
exception_flows.handling: The waiver is refused.

nfrs: Clearance owners can clear items from mobile.
Each status change stores actor, timestamp and note.

user_stories.want: F&F held while any blocking clearance item is open
user_stories.so_that: no settlement is paid with assets or dues outstanding

use_cases.name: Settle full and final on the last working day
use_cases.goal: Compute, approve and pay the full and final settlement on the last working day once clearance permits.

stakeholders.interest: Correct dues paid on the last day.
Settlement reaches the bank file only when cleared.

use_cases.trigger: All blocking clearance items are cleared or waived.
preconditions: F&F is READY.
The last working day, notice position and leave balance are final.
postconditions_success: F&F is SETTLED, included in its own run and bank file, and relieving documents are issued.
postconditions_failure: F&F stays READY or HELD with reason; no payment is made.

main_flow.action: Moves F&F to READY when no blocking item remains and opens the settlement on SCR-056.
Computes final salary to the last working day, leave encashment, gratuity where eligible and notice pay or recovery.
Adds loan, advance and asset recovery lines, including values from waived clearance items.
Computes statutory deductions and the net amount.
Reviews the working, line by line with its basis, and approves the settlement.
Includes the settlement in the full and final run and its bank file.
Releases the payment; the platform marks F&F SETTLED and emits payroll.fnf.settled.
Issues the relieving letter and experience certificate.

steps: Platform shows the amount due from the leaver and creates a recovery request.
No negative payment line enters the bank file.

exception_flows.condition: A blocking item is reopened.
exception_flows.handling: F&F returns to HELD and is removed from the pending bank file.

exception_flows.condition: Saving the settlement fails.
exception_flows.handling: The error is shown with its cause and no partial record is stored; the user can retry.

nfrs: The settlement working saves successfully at every state transition.
Each line shows its basis so the leaver can verify it.

user_stories.want: each settlement line with its basis
user_stories.so_that: I can approve quickly and answer the leaver's questions

use_cases.name: Allocate and recover company assets
use_cases.goal: Maintain an asset register where every allocation is tracked to return and surfaces automatically as a clearance item at exit.

stakeholders.interest: Unreturned assets are recovered at their value.
A clear record of what was issued and returned.

use_cases.trigger: An employee joins, needs an asset, or exits.
preconditions: Asset types carry a blocking flag and recovery value.
postconditions_success: Allocation and return are recorded with dates and condition; unreturned assets become recovery lines.
postconditions_failure: The asset remains allocated and the clearance item stays open.

main_flow.action: Selects an available asset on SCR-064 and allocates it to the employee with issue date and condition.
Acknowledges receipt of the asset in self-service.
Registers the allocation as a future clearance item, blocking for high-value assets.
At exit, adds each open allocation to the leaver's clearance checklist.
Records the return with date and condition, clearing the item.
Updates the asset to Available or Under repair based on condition.

steps: Director / approver waives the item with reason.
Platform creates a recovery line at the asset's recovery value.

alternate_flows.condition: The asset is worn beyond use.
steps: Admin / IT writes it off with reason; no recovery is charged.

exception_flows.condition: The asset is already allocated.
exception_flows.handling: Allocation is refused and the current holder is shown.

exception_flows.condition: A return is recorded by someone other than the asset owner role.
exception_flows.handling: The update is refused.

nfrs: Register searchable by asset code or serial within 1 second.

user_stories.want: every issued asset to appear automatically on the leaver's clearance list
user_stories.so_that: nothing is forgotten at exit

use_cases.name: Orchestrate background verification before joining
use_cases.goal: Initiate background checks with providers, track each component and gate joining on configurable mandatory checks.

stakeholders.interest: Checks run with consent and within purpose.
No delay where checks are not mandatory.

use_cases.trigger: An offer is accepted for a role whose check package is configured.
preconditions: Check packages are configured per worker class and location, with each component marked mandatory or not.
The candidate has given consent for verification.
postconditions_success: Each component has a final status; all mandatory components are Clear and the joining gate is open.
postconditions_failure: A mandatory component is Discrepant or Pending and joining is held.

main_flow.action: Selects the check package for the worker class and location and records the candidate's consent.
Sends the check request to the provider through the integration service.
Returns status updates per component (identity, address, education, previous employment).
Shows component status on the pre-boarding tracker.
Reviews any discrepancy with the candidate's explanation and records a decision.
Opens the joining gate when all mandatory components are Clear or decided.

steps: HR records the reason; the component is marked Accepted with exception.

exception_flows.condition: The provider exceeds its turnaround SLA.

nfrs: Provider reports are stored encrypted and access is logged.

use_cases.name: Apply for internal roles and run inter-entity transfers
use_cases.goal: Let employees apply for internal roles and let HR move people between entities with continuity of service, leave and statutory accounts.

stakeholders.interest: Career growth without losing service or balances.
Clean cut-over between entity payrolls.

use_cases.trigger: An internal role is published, or an inter-entity transfer is approved.
preconditions: Internal eligibility rules (minimum tenure, performance band) are configured.
Both entities are set up with payroll groups and statutory registrations.
postconditions_success: The employee holds an assignment in the target entity with original service date, carried leave balances and continuous UAN.
No exit or F&F is triggered for an inter-entity transfer.
postconditions_failure: The application is closed with reason or the transfer is held; the current assignment continues.

main_flow.action: Views internal openings for which they are eligible and applies with a short statement.
Notifies the current manager and routes the application to the hiring manager.
Records a release decision and agreed release date.
Approves the move and, for a different entity, initiates the inter-entity transfer.
Ends the source assignment and creates the target assignment, preserving the continuous service date.
Carries leave balances and keeps the same UAN; re-resolves ESI, PT and LWF for the new entity and location.
Confirms the cut-over date in both entity payrolls.

alternate_flows.condition: HR initiates the transfer without an application.
steps: HR selects employee, target entity and date.

exception_flows.condition: The employee does not meet eligibility.
exception_flows.handling: The apply action is not offered and the unmet criterion is shown.

exception_flows.condition: A leave type does not exist in the target entity.
exception_flows.handling: HR is shown the balance and must map or encash it before the transfer completes.

nfrs: Service continuity is preserved for gratuity and leave accrual purposes (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: to apply for an internal role from self-service
user_stories.so_that: I can grow without leaving the company

use_cases.name: Record rehire eligibility and maintain alumni
use_cases.goal: Record whether a leaver may be rehired and keep a consented alumni record for future hiring.

stakeholders.interest: Former good performers are easy to find.
Alumni contact only with consent.

preconditions: Rehire eligibility reason codes are configured.
postconditions_success: Rehire eligibility is recorded and an alumni record exists if consent was given.
postconditions_failure: No alumni record exists and the rehire flag defaults to Review required.

use_cases.name: Capture exit interviews and attrition reasons
use_cases.goal: Capture structured exit reasons and interview responses and report attrition patterns without identifying individuals.

stakeholders.interest: Reliable attrition drivers by site and department.
Candid feedback does not reach their manager attributably.

preconditions: An exit questionnaire and reason code taxonomy are configured.
The exit interview is a non-blocking clearance item.
postconditions_success: Responses and primary and secondary reasons are stored; reports aggregate them anonymously.
postconditions_failure: The interview remains open; the leaver's exit proceeds unaffected.

main_flow.action: Adds the exit interview as a non-blocking item to the clearance checklist.
Completes the structured questionnaire in self-service.
Holds the interview and records primary and secondary reason codes.
Records the manager's view of the reason separately.
Stores responses with access restricted to HR roles.
Produces attrition reports by reason, site, department and tenure band with small cohorts suppressed.

steps: HR records 'declined' and the item is closed.

exception_flows.condition: A report cell would contain fewer than 5 leavers.
exception_flows.handling: The cell is suppressed and merged into 'Other'.

nfrs: Free-text answers are excluded from reports viewable by managers.

user_stories.want: structured primary and secondary exit reasons
user_stories.so_that: attrition reports show real drivers

acceptance.given: I interview E1068

acceptance.then: the open interview does not hold F&F

user_stories.want: attrition reports that do not identify individuals
user_stories.so_that: I can act on patterns without breaching confidence
